headerDisplay: Sign in with your Mitsubishi **Wi-Fi Control** account. The plugin discovers units via Melview and applies optional HomeKit features from each unit's reported capabilities (including Wi-Fi module type).
footerDisplay: Wi-Fi modules such as MAC-568IF-E / MAC-577IF-E are detected from Melview `adaptortype`. Optional features still respect per-unit hardware flags (dry, outdoor temp, horizontal swing, etc.).

name.title: Name
name.description: Platform instance name shown in Homebridge logs.

capabilityMode.title: Feature mode

oneOf.title: Auto — enable features Melview says the unit supports
Manual — only enable the toggles below

capabilityMode.description: Auto uses each unit's Melview capability flags (hasdrymode, hasoutdoortemp, hasairdirh). Vertical swing and fan speed stay opt-in even in Auto because they can affect tile reliability.

preferLocalControl.title: Prefer LAN control hop
preferLocalControl.description: After Melview accepts a command, also POST the encrypted payload to the unit's `/smart` endpoint when a LAN IP is known (MAC-568 / MAC-577 family).

dry.title: Dry mode (dehumidifier tile)
dry.description: Manual mode: add a Dehumidifier service when the unit supports dry mode.

fanMode.title: Fan-only mode
fanMode.description: Add a Fan service for fan-only operation. Also added automatically when fan speed is enabled.

swingMode.title: Vertical airflow swing
swingMode.description: Opt-in vertical swing on the main AC tile. Leave off if power toggles become unreliable.

airflowH.title: Horizontal airflow swing
airflowH.description: Manual mode: horizontal louvre swing switch when Melview reports hasairdirh.

fanSpeed.title: Fan speed control
fanSpeed.description: Experimental fan-speed slider on a separate Fan service.

fanSpeedOnMainTile.title: Fan speed on main AC tile
fanSpeedOnMainTile.description: Also expose fan speed on the HeaterCooler tile (requires fan speed enabled).

outdoorTemp.title: Outdoor temperature sensor
outdoorTemp.description: Manual mode: Temperature Sensor when Melview reports hasoutdoortemp.

pollIntervalSeconds.title: Polling interval (seconds)
pollIntervalSeconds.description: How often to refresh each unit from Melview.

perUnitOverrides.title: Per-unit overrides
perUnitOverrides.description: Override feature toggles for a specific Melview unit ID.

unitId.title: Unit ID
unitId.description: Melview unitid from plugin logs / Melview account.

fanSpeedOnMainTile.title: Fan speed on main AC tile

layout.title: Manual feature toggles
layout.description: Used when Feature mode is Manual. In Auto, dry / outdoor temp / horizontal swing follow Melview capabilities; these toggles still force features on if set true.
